DR31 is a medical diagnosis code representing "blood in urine without further specification" (hematuria) [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring, specifically within the Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) database managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), DR31 plays a specific role in tracking patient safety and clinical outcomes [^src1]. 

Specifically, DR31 is utilized as one of the diagnostic codes to identify the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src3]. The AFDK annual reports detail a comprehensive methodology for measuring the quality of diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up for atrial fibrillation patients across Danish regions [^src1]. To accurately capture severe bleeding events—a critical complication for patients often managed with anticoagulant therapy—the registry employs a broad spectrum of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes to ensure thorough register-based analyses [^src1].

Within this coding framework, DR31 is grouped alongside other codes like [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], and [[dr04|DR04]] to capture urinary tract and pulmonary bleeding events [^src1]. Other code ranges cover intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]]–[[ds066|DS066]]) and gastrointestinal bleeding (e.g., [[dk25-0|DK25.0]]–[[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]]–[[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) [^src1]. The consistent inclusion of DR31 in the methodological definitions across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 AFDK reports underscores its ongoing relevance as a technical reference for clinical quality measurement in the national healthcare system [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
